rule: A v1 hardening behaviour may be dropped only through a pre-registered ledger entry.

replay_report.reason: The C2 replay against v1 MCP traffic needs the recorded corpus and the cloud lane; not claimed locally.

entries.v1: MCP scanning is off unless scan controls or flags are set on the server
entries.v2: the org's firewall plan applies, the same rules as chat

entries.v1: two separate flags enable Tier-2 scanning
a redact that cannot mask never escalates to block
entries.v2: withholds: input_unmaskable on input, scan_failure on output

entries.v1: forwards a gateway OAuth token or a control-stored token
entries.v2: refused with mcp_upstream_auth_unsupported (HTTP 403); operator decision auth_servers=refuse

entries.topic: gateway SSRF on the sandbox path
entries.v1: no gateway-side check on the sandbox path
entries.v2: dispatch/url_guard.check_remote before every remote call; stdio commands checked against an allow-list

entries.v1: any non-empty agent flag disables the check; the gateway allowlist skips the metadata check
entries.v2: exact hosts only (AMF_DEV_MCP_ALLOW_INTERNAL_HOSTS); metadata, loopback and link-local are always refused

entries.v1: block posture withholds; other postures mask every block
entries.v2: detected through join runs; redact applies per leaf; a span that straddles two leaves withholds

entries.v1: org from the URL, checked against the key
entries.v2: org from the key only; mapped to control's slug through AMF_DEV_MCP_ORG_MAP

entries.v1: org route, REST tools routes, ext-proxy, internal tools call, OAuth flow
entries.v2: POST /v1/mcp/{server_slug} only; the other MCP rows stay retire in the GW14b admin ledger

entries.topic: per-key tool allow-list and per-key call cap
entries.v1: mcp_allowed_tools and mcp_max_tool_calls enforced per API key
entries.v2: not implemented; the per-server enabled-tools set and org admission/budget apply
